srcFingerprint.method: sha256 over sorted relative path + NUL + file bytes + NUL

window.calendarYears: game calendar years 1–3; stop at exact year-4 boundary

dailyActionBudget: Within each in-game day, choose legal actions until engine-managed time/stamina costs leave no useful action budget. Stop at the next midnight boundary or the first no-progress decision (hard cap: 80 policy decisions/day), then simulate only the remainder to midnight. An action may advance across midnight.

routePolicies.life: Only legal public gather/farm/craft/sell/rest/travel actions; never starts a voluntary encounter. Repeats decisions within the day until stamina/time is spent, resting when needed.
routePolicies.adventure: Explores reachable regions, chooses only currently eligible encounter targets / legal forest encounters, equips legal upgrades, fights or retreats; no farming/crafting/trading unless needed to recover. Repeats decisions within the day until stamina/time is spent.
routePolicies.hybrid: Alternates Life and Adventure by in-game day; repeats decisions during that day until stamina/time budget is spent. An active combat is resolved before the day ends. Both halves must complete successful actions per seed.

label: Normal fresh-save (scripted policy); not a human playtest and not a controlled fixture
